metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.1 · 2008 · The Strangers
metas.description: James Hoyt and Kristen McKay visit an isolated vacation home to enjoy some time together. However, they are in for a rude surprise when three masked assailants make their stay a nightmare.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.3 · 2018 · The Strangers: Prey at Night
metas.description: A family of four staying at a secluded mobile home park for the night are stalked and then hunted by three masked psychopaths.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 4.7 · 2024 · The Strangers: Chapter 1
metas.description: After their car breaks down in an eerie small town, a young couple is forced to spend the night in a remote cabin. Panic ensues as they are terrorized by three masked strangers who strike with no mercy and seemingly no motive.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 4.7 · 2025 · The Strangers: Chapter 2
metas.description: Left stranded in a small town with no way out, Maya must once again face a night of terror courtesy of three deadly killers whose rampage she must put to an end.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 4.2 · 2026 · The Strangers: Chapter 3
metas.description: In the series' most brutal chapter, Maya collides with the masked killers and finds the only way out of the nightmare...is in.
